# SyntraForge — Complete Technical & Product Reference (syntraforge.me)
> Privacy-first, zero-upload browser media & developer utility platform engineered by Mohammad Junaid.

## Architecture & Privacy Guarantee
Unlike cloud converters that upload files to third-party servers, SyntraForge processes every image, video, audio file, and QR payload strictly inside the user's local browser memory. No user media ever leaves the device.

## Capabilities & Use Cases
1. **Image Compression (/compress)**: Batch WebP/JPEG/PNG optimization, exact file-size targeting for portal uploads, and Core Web Vitals asset reduction.
2. **Video Frame Extraction (/frame)**: Frame-by-frame scrubbing and instant 4K still capture from gameplay clips, drone footage, and mobile videos.
3. **Browser Audio Studio (/audio)**: Waveform trimming, dead-silence removal, ringtone cutting, and fade-in/out rendering via Web Audio API.
4. **Vector QR Generator (/qr)**: Crisp vector SVG and high-DPI PNG generation for commercial packaging, menus, posters, and business cards.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **Are my files uploaded to a server?** No. All processing happens 100% locally in your web browser.
- **Is SyntraForge free to use?** Yes, all utilities and engineering guides are completely free with no account required.
